rawContent: Came across this 2011 "Men Speak Out About Sexist Coverage of Rape:A Call to Action" signed by a boatload of male feminist-aligned activists back in the day. Wonder what happened to the momentum behind this, as the silence is deafening on rape culture in Black communities? #MeToo https://t.co/skRxrUPf6w
